Utility: Used to add the following Affinities to *any* Ash of War: - Heavy: Increases STR scaling, decreases all other scalings. - Keen: Increases DEX scaling, decreases all other scalings. - Quality: Balances STR and DEX scalings, decreases base damage.

title: Glintstone Whetblade
description: Location: In a small room, up in on the balcony. Utility: Used to add the following Affinities to physical and magic Ashes of War: - Magic: Increases INT scaling, decreases all other scalings. Adds magic damage, reduces base damage. While guarding, increases Magic defense, decreases all other defenses. - Cold: Increases INT scaling, decreases all other scalings. Adds magic damage, reduces base damage. Grants Frostbite buildup while attacking.

title: Red-Hot Whetblade

Adds fire damage, reduces base damage. While guarding, increases Fire defense, decreases all other defenses. Changes fire damage scaling to STR instead of FAI. - Flame Art: Increases FAI scaling, decreases all other scalings. Adds fire damage, reduces base damage.

title: Sanctified Whetblade
description: Location: Inside the manor, in the first floor's south wing. On a corpse past a broken wall. Utility: Used to add the following Affinities to physical and golden Ashes of War: - Sacred: Increases FAI scaling, decreases all other scalings. Adds Holy damage, reduces base damage. While guarding, increases Holy defense, decreses all other defenses. - Lightning: Increases DEX scaling, decreases all other scalings. Adds Lightning damage, reduces base damage. While guarding, increases Lightning defense, decreses all other defenses.

title: Black Whetblade
description: Location: In front of the altar, on a corpse. Utility: Used to add the following Affinities to physical and occult Ashes of War: - Poison: Increases STR, DEX and ARC scaling. Grants Poison buildup while attacking. - Blood: Increases ARC scaling, decreases all other scalings. Grants Bleed buildup while attacking, or empowers an existing Bleed effect, scaling with ARC. - Occult: Increases ARC scaling, decreases all other scalings.

title: Extreme Repentance
description: Location: Given by [Patches](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=164504) under the following conditions: 1. Befriend him by sparing his life during the first encounter. Let the fight end completely. Doing so will reward you with [Grovel for Mercy](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=165136). 2. Reinitiate the fight by attacking him a few times. 3. Let Patches attack you until your HP drops low enough (approximately below 50%). He will then offer to accept your surrender, automatically granting you Extreme Repentance. 4. Perform the newly obtained gesture while your HP is still low to make Patches stop attacking and become friendly again. Note: Performing Grovel for Mercy is not required to obtain Extreme Repentance, as the gesture is awarded automatically when Patches offers you the chance to surrender.

title: Kenneth Haight
description: Location: Found on top of the giant arch Quest: [Kenneth Haight's Quest](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=164854) Note: If killed, drops a [golden seed](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=169288).

description: Location: Inside a side building, by a dead guard. Speak to her and exhaust her dialogue to have her available as a summon against [Godrick the Grafted](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=164421)

title: Bloody Finger Hunter Yura (Murkwater Cave)

Quest: Part of [Yura's Quest](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=170973); he spawns here after completing step 3.

title: Boc (Coastal Cave)

Quest: Part of [Boc's Quest](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=165122); give him the [Sewing Needle](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=164459) to advance the quest.

Blaidd will spawn here.

title: Sorceress Sellen (Prisoner)

title: D (Summonwater Village)
description: Location: At the entrance of [Summonwater Village](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=164017). Quest: Part of [D's Quest](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=167218); he relocates here after step 1. title: Sorcerer Thops (Raya Lucaria Academy)
description: Note: Can be found dead after completing [Sorcerer Thops' Quest](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=165848). Loot: - [Thops's Bell Bearing](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=165854) - [Academy Glintstone Staff](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=165855) - [Thops's Barrier](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=165856)

title: Finger Reader
description: Location: Next to the collapsed bridge connecting Limgrave and Liurnia. Tells the Tarnished about the two crescent halves—[Dectus Medallion (Left)](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=164496) and [Dectus Medallion (Right)](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=166653)—that they must bring together at the [Grand Lift of Dectus](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=164180). _Head to the foundation of gold, Tarnished... Traverse Raya Lucaria; "Glintstone Eventide"... ...and reunite the half crescents, at the Grand Lift. Oh, but the bridge is collapsed, and cannot be crossed. Only, why should that matter! Stormveil Castle still stands tall!_

title: Finger Reader Crone
description: Informs you of the Radahn Festival at Redmane Castle and of Millicent. "...Are you one for festivals? Or flowers? To the South, a grand festival to make the stars turn. To the East, the hardened bud of a flower to be. But dare you enter? Into the heart of the scarlet rot?"

title: Finger Reader
description: "Slaughter, slaughter, slaughter... The all-hearing slaughtered, but alas, it was for naught. But all you need do, is snatch it from the big pot.Pity the poor, poor fool!".

title: Boc (Grand Library)
description: Location: Kneeling by [Rennala](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=165895). Quest: Part of [Boc's Quest](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=165122); one of the alternate endings. Note: From there, Boc can no longer be interacted with.

title: D's Brother (Siofra)
description: Location: Near the [Prince of Death's Throne](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=167604) Site of Grace. Quest: Part of [D's Quest](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=167218). Speak with him, then reload the area to obtain the [Twinned Set](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=168994) (again) and the [Inseparable Sword](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=169172).

title: Kenneth Haight (Throne Room)
description: Location: To the left of the throne, in [Stormveil Castle](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=164053). Quest: [Kenneth Haight's Quest](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=164854)

title: Nepheli Loux (Throne Room)
description: Location: To the left of the throne, in [Stormveil Castle](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=164053). Quest: [Nepheli's Quest](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=169124)

title: Nepheli Loux (Library)
description: Location: In the library of [Roundtable Hold](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=165686). Quest: Part of [Nepheli's Quest](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=169124); she relocates here after step 2. Speak with her to receive the Arsenal Charm.

title: Nepheli Loux (Downstairs)
description: Location: Down the stairs, by the fog wall. Quest: Part of [Nepheli's Quest](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=169124); she relocates here after step 6.

title: Patches (5th Location)
description: Location: On the wooden bridge before Elemer of the Briar. Appears here after defeating [Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=167571). Will give you the [Dancer's Castanets](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=175929) after speaking with him. Quest: [Patches' Quest](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=166248)

title: Patches (4th Location)
description: Location: In the entrance corridor of the manor, before the room with Tanith. Appears here after you join the Volcano Manor (unrelated to falling in his trap on Mt. Gelmir) Quest: [Patches' Quest](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=166248)

title: Rya (2nd Location - Alternate)
description: She will be there if you gave her the necklace from Blackguard at Liurnia of the lakes. Teleports you to Volcano Manor if you take her hands. Only appears here if you arrive through [Ruin-Strewn Precipice](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=165513) rather than the [Grand Lift of Dectus](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=164180) Quest: [Rya's Quest](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=166813)

title: Hyetta (5th location)
description: Location: At the very bottom of the [Subterranean Shunning Grounds](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=175442). Get to the [Frenzied Flame Proscription](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=168677) Site of Grace, then open the secret passage and descend the depths. Quest: [Hyetta's Quest](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=169804)

title: Rya (3rd location)
description: Down the hall from [Tanith](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=167573), inside the room through the second door on the right. Quest: [Rya's Quest](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=166813)

title: Rya (5th location)
description: Quest: [Rya's Quest](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=166813)

title: Brother Corhyn (6th location)
description: Location: Kneeling, at the base of the giant spiral spear. Quest: [Brother Corhyn's Quest](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=178950)

title: Goldmask (Final location)
description: Location: On a cliff, west of the log bridge. Quest: [Brother Corhyn's Quest](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=178950). Note: After progressing the quest, visit the body to loot [Mending Rune of Perfect Order](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=177441). Reload the area, then visit it again to loot [Goldmask Armor Set](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=177442).

title: Ensha
description: Location: [Roundtable Hold](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=165686) - Near [Gideon Ofnir](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=169061). Note: After receiving either [Haligtree Secret Medallion (Right)](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=167191) or [Haligtree Secret Medallion (Left)](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=167291), he will turn into [an invader](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=167506).

title: Diallos (4th Location)
description: Location: In one of the houses, tending to a jar Quest: [Diallos' Quest](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=167784)

title: Melina
description: Appears after resting at a Site of Grace once you've discovered three of them.

title: Needle Knight Leda (First Meeting)
description: Needle Knight Leda will be the first person you see before jumping into the Shadow of the Erdtree DLC. You can find her at the Mohgywn Dynasty Mausoleum in the Lands Between, which is located in the underground section of the map beneath Caelid.

title: Noble Ghost
description: Location: [Castle Morne](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=163951) - in a cage in the cell behind the castle

title: Ghost
description: _"The demi-humans wax wroth, now their mother's been taken..._ _Where are you, Lord Kenneth?_ _The knight... bedeviled by blood."_

title: Ghost
description: Speak to him and receive a hint about the [Tower of Return](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=163981)

title: Ghost
description: Sitting on the edge of the cliff by the [Rotview Balcony](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=164372) Site of Grace. _It's rotting. Everything, rotting scarlet. The very earth that Caelid rests upon, and Sellia, town of Sorcery. The end is nigh, for us all._

title: Ghost
description: On the left as you enter the lift chamber _"...It's there, somewhere. Another path, leading back to the foot of the Erdtree. An ancient tunnel."_

title: Ghost
description: Ghost just beyond the Liurnia Highway North Site of Grace. "Ahh, the puppets..." "The puppets besiege us..."

title: Ghost
description: _"Ahh, Lord Vyke, it seems that you were no lord, after all."_ _"Then where is he? Our true Lord, our Lord of Frenzied Flame."_ _"We beg of you, incinerate all that divides and distinguishes."_ _"Ahh, may chaos take the world!"_

title: Ghost
description: Sitting on a small rock outside the ruin _"Come out, one and all, from the darkness underground."_ _"And let us offer unto the maiden our eyes."_

title: Ghost
description: Sitting outside the [Church of Pilgrimage](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=163994) "*The mausoleum prowls. Cradling the soulless demigod.* *O Marika, Queen Eternal. He is your unwanted child.*"

title: Ghost
description: In the [Nokron, Eternal City](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=167493) area. Watch out - you may be ambushed while listening to it.

title: Ghost
description: "Let me see it, if only one last time. Your splendid blade, dancing amongst the scarlet rot"

title: Ghost
description: Found sitting on the floor of the East side of Kingsrealm Ruins. " Ah, Iji, forgive me. These royal grounds were placed in our trust, but we stood no chance.:

title: Ghost
description: _"I'm dry, dry as a bone..._ _Foul dragon, surrender your strength._ _Let me feast on your heart."_

title: Ghost
description: Near the edge of the rock, gazing at the minor erdtree. _"O Sapling! Sweet sapling of glorious gold. Has your crystal teardrop ripened?"_

title: Ghost
description: _"..."_ "_Ahh_, _the poor fellow_..._gone perfectly mad_." "_Love_..._revenge_..._the frenzied flame melts it all away_..."

title: Ghost
description: _"Raya Lucaria, hallowed hall dedicated to the study of magic."_ _"Why shut your doors to me? Am I barred from donning the crown of stone?"_

title: Ghost
description: "Maiden, dear maiden, where are you? Please, take my grapes."

title: Ghost
description: On the small cliff, facing the erdtree.

title: Ghost
description: In the Church of the Eclipse

title: Ghost
description: Just beyond the Site of Grace in the Windmill Village, amongst a broken wagon. " Eek... I hear a festive melody... No, no, don't skin me... My hide is filthy, I swear."

title: Ghost
description: Lying in front of the fire

title: Ghost
description: Ghost localizado em Altus Plateau.

title: Ghost
description: Next to the entrance in the study hall. _"O Celestial Globe, transmit to posterity. The wisdom of the moon and stars. And obscure, forever, the transgressions of the princess."_

title: Ghost
description: Add the edge of the cliff. "... Sublime, I tell you. The very first flower of Aeonia bloomed on this very spot. Malenia, may you blossom into a goddess."

title: Ghost
description: Ghost localizado em Mountaintops of the Giants.

title: Ghost
description: Sitting inside Caria Manor's southwest room, under Manor Lower Level site of grace. "Lady Ranni, we have long awaited you. I pray for your house's swift revival. May the full moon shine upon Caria."

title: Ghost
description: Sitting on a stone, facing north. Just east of the Guide Statue. ... Only ... a little further now... Show met the path, O gentle lights ... the path to Elphael.

title: Ghost
description: Location: Outside Deathtouched Catacombs. "Unthinkable. Our hollowed resting place is violated. To refuse the Erdtree's call to return, to live within Death... Sickening."

title: Ghost
description: _"Mohg, you rotten Omen. Your blood is cursed. Give him back. Give Lord Miquella back! How dare you lay hands on such precious flesh."_

title: Ghost
description: Location: [Fort Gael](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=164412) - After entering the castle through the backladder, cross the wooden beam, on the wall looking over Caelid. _"Convene the festival of war. Honor General Radahn, with a warrior's glory. It's in your hands, Sir Jerren."_

title: Albinauric Ghost
description: Ghost localizado em Mountaintops of the Giants.

title: Ghost
description: Location: Stormfoot Catacombs, at the entrance, just in front of the site of grace. _A proper death means returning to the Erdtree. Have patience. Until the time comes...and the roots call to you._

title: Ghost
description: Ghost localizado em Mountaintops of the Giants.

title: Ghost
description: _Heh heh... I'll survive, I swear it. I'll soon be back at Volcano Manor._

title: Ghost
description: Sitting near a well at the Village of the Albinaurics Site of Grace. _"This village is done for. Please, even if it's just you, old Albus, hide well and still your breath."_

title: Ghost
description: Sitting in a chair overlooking the Cave of Knowledge.

title: Artist
description: Spawns after interacting with the ["Resurrection" Painting](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=166624) at the [Artist's Shack](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=169464). Rewards a [Larval Tear](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=167689) and the [Juvenile Scholar Set](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=167690)

title: Patches
