title: Count Ymir's Quest
description: How to Begin: Speak with [Count Ymir ](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-shadow-realm?locationIds=381272) Steps: 1. Speak with [Count Ymir](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-shadow-realm?locationIds=381272), he will tell you to sound a bell after giving you a map which tells you its location and a Hole-Laden Necklace 2. Go to the [Hanging Bell](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-shadow-realm?locationIds=382251) and sound the Bell 3. Return to [Ymir](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-shadow-realm?locationIds=381272), he will give you second ruins location and Talisman: Beloved Stardust. 4. Sound the second bell in [Finger Ruins of Dheo](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-shadow-realm?locationIds=382345) 5. Return to [Ymir](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-shadow-realm?locationIds=381272), talk with him and he will give you third ruins map. 6. Reload the area and interact with his throne to reveal a ladder down. 7. Sound the bell in the area below the ladder to be taken to the boss fight: [Mityr, Mother of Fingers](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-shadow-realm?locationIds=382002), Defeat it and return to the Chapel 8. Approach the Throne and you will be invaded by Jolan, Defeating him summons Ymir as a boss.

title: St. Trina's Quest
description: How to Begin: Speak to [St. Trina](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-shadow-realm?locationIds=382315) after defeating the [Putrescent Knight](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-shadow-realm?locationIds=381961) Steps: 1. Speak to St. Trina and "Imbibe Nectar" four times (and die) 2. Speak to St. Trina and "Imbibe Nectar" for the fifth time and get cutscene dialog 3. Speak to St. Trina and "Imbibe Nectar" for the sixth time and get cutscene dialog 4. Speak with [Thiollier](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-shadow-realm?locationIds=381963) to progress his dialogue 5. Reload area and [Thiollier will invade](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-shadow-realm?locationIds=382633).

title: Needle Knight Leda's Questline
description: How to Begin: Pick up the [Tower of Shadow Message](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-shadow-realm?locationIds=380804). You must have spoken to Leda before entering the Shadow Realm for the quest to properly trigger. Steps: 1. Read the [Castle Cross Message](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-shadow-realm?locationIds=381194) 2. Speak to [Needle Knight Leda](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-shadow-realm?locationIds=380252) 3. Break the Great Rune; approach [Shadow Keep](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-shadow-realm?locationIds=381342) until you get a game notification that "somewhere, a great rune has broken". 4. Speak with Needle Knight Leda again. 5. Complete [Leda's Questline (1st battle)](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-shadow-realm?locationIds=381987) (see the battle for choice repercussions) 6. Speak with Needle Knight Leda to receive the [Lacerating Crossed-Tree](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-shadow-realm?locationIds=386478). 7. Complete [Leda's Questline (2nd battle)](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-shadow-realm?locationIds=381988) (see the battle for choice repercussions) 8. Speak with Needle Knight Leda to receive the [Retaliatory Crossed-Tree Talisman](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-shadow-realm?locationIds=386477). 9. Defeat [Needle Knight Leda](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-shadow-realm?locationIds=384098)

title: Hornsent's Questline
description: How to Begin: Speak with [Redmane Freyja](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-shadow-realm?locationIds=380738). Steps: 1. Speak with [Hornsent](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-shadow-realm?locationIds=380739) 2. Speak with Horsent at his [new location](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-shadow-realm?locationIds=380254). 3. Break the Great Rune; approach [Shadow Keep](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-shadow-realm?locationIds=381342) until you get a game notification that "somewhere, a great rune has broken". 4. Speak with Hornsent again. 5. Complete [Leda's Questline (1st battle)](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-shadow-realm?locationIds=381987) (see the battle for choice repercussions) 6. Summon Hornsent to battle [Messmer the Impaler](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-shadow-realm?locationIds=381741). 7. Defeat Hornsent. either: - [As an invader](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-shadow-realm?locationIds=382691); - As an ally of [Needle Knight Leda](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-shadow-realm?locationIds=384098)

title: Sir Ansbach's Questline
description: How to Begin: Speak with [Sir Ansbach](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-shadow-realm?locationIds=380752) Steps: 1. Interact with the [Miquella's Cross](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-shadow-realm?locationIds=382123) 2. Speak with Sir Ansbach again. 3. Break the Great Rune; approach [Shadow Keep](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-shadow-realm?locationIds=381342) until you get a game notification that "somewhere, a great rune has broken". 4. Speak with Sir Ansbach in his [new location](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-shadow-realm?locationIds=382217). 5. Read the [Storehouse Cross Message](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-shadow-realm?locationIds=381713) 6. Speak with [Redmane Freyja](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-shadow-realm?locationIds=383036) 7. Speak with Ansbach again; he will give you a letter to give to Freyja. 8. Acquire the [Secret Rite Scroll](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-shadow-realm?locationIds=381721) 9. Give the scroll to Ansbach. 10. Complete [Leda's Questline (2nd battle)](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-shadow-realm?locationIds=381988) (see the battle for each choice's outcomes). 11. Summon Ansbach against [Promised Consort Radahn](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-shadow-realm?locationIds=382044). If you do, you will receive [Ansbach's Set](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-shadow-realm?locationIds=386515) after defeating him. Note: Steps 6 and 7 are optional, but required for ??.

title: Dragon Communion Priestess' Questline
description: How to Begin: Speak with [Dragon Communion Priestess](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-shadow-realm?locationIds=382198). Steps: 1. Speak with the Dragon Communion Priestess, and agree to devour Draconic Essence. 2. Defeat [Bayle the Dread](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-shadow-realm?locationIds=381971). 3. Return to her; she will be gone, leaving behind [Priestess Heart](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-shadow-realm?locationIds=405579) and [Flowerstone Gavel](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-shadow-realm?locationIds=382525). _Alternate completion:_ 1. Speak with [Moore](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-shadow-realm?locationIds=380751), then with [Thiollier](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-shadow-realm?locationIds=381018). Make sure to not progress through Shadow Keep, as this causes Thiollier to move. You will receive [Black Syrup](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-shadow-realm?locationIds=384432). 2. Give the syrup to [Thiollier](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-shadow-realm?locationIds=381018) to recieve [Thiollier's Concoction](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-shadow-realm?locationIds=543812) 3. After speaking with the Dragon Communion Priestess at least once, return at nighttime and give her the concoction. 4. After defeating Bayle, when you return, she will still be there, offering you [Dragonbolt of Florissax](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-shadow-realm?locationIds=387449) and [Ancient Dragon Florissax Ashes](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-shadow-realm?locationIds=387450) instead.
